why: Item 1 is broken. Check 4 of the verifier brief tells the verifier to run `curl -sSL https://o.github.io/greet-cli/` and decides on what that fetch returns today. It passes if "the fetched page ... contains `--shout`" and fails if "the page cannot be fetched, or the fetched page does not contain `--shout`". It also says to "report FAIL" when the PR is not merged yet, which turns a criterion that can only be decided after merge into a FAIL at the PR head instead of leaving it open as pending. Item 2 holds, because Check 4 never passes silently without evidence. The builder brief correctly marks the criterion as post-merge, but the verifier brief still breaks item 1.
